queue.title: Arthur Hayes: Fed-Backed Yen Rescue Could Fuel Bitcoin, Gold and Ether BitMEX co-founder Arthur Hayes said the most likely path to a stronger yen is not aggressive Bank of Japan rate hikes or large-scale Treasury sales, but Japan using the Federal Reserve’s FIMA repo facility to pledge U.S. Treasuries for dollars and then sell those dollars to buy yen. He argued that if the current USD 60 billion counterparty cap is raised, the Fed’s balance sheet could expand, with roughly USD 1.37 trillion of Treasuries held by the Japanese government and GPIF potentially serving as collateral. Hayes said the resulting dollar liquidity would be bullish for Bitcoin, gold and Ether.

Anthropic Strikes $9.1 Billion Compute Deal With Bitcoin Miner Riot Anthropic has struck a 20-year, $9.1 billion data-center deal with Riot Platforms to secure 191 MW of computing capacity at Riot’s Rockdale campus in Texas, as the Claude maker races to lock in infrastructure for growing AI demand. The full capacity is expected to come online by June 2028, while two five-year extension options could lift the total contract value to about $16.1 billion.

queue.title: Ravencoin Faces Deep Reorg Risk After Consensus Bug Exploited Ravencoin said a critical consensus vulnerability was exploited on its network, causing some nodes to accept invalid blocks, with the first known invalid block appearing at height 4,487,776. Mining pools 2Miners and RavenMiner are now building a chain that excludes the affected branch; if it becomes dominant, the network could undergo a reorganization rolling back roughly three days of transactions. Ravencoin advised exchanges to temporarily suspend RVN deposits and withdrawals and treat transactions after block 4,487,775 as potentially reversible.
